Example 1 (2024-08-26):
- History: Prices are around 70-73, showing some volatility
- Sentiment: Mix of values from -0.33 to 1.00
- Model forecasts: Start around 70.66-71.80, gradually declining to ~69-72 range
- True outcomes: Start around 70.49-71.49, then **significantly decline** to 60-62 range

The model is severely underpredicting the decline! It only goes to ~72 in its forecast, but true prices drop to 60-62 (an 8-10 euro drop!).
